summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed marine fuels wholesaler (Nasdaq: UFG), furnished a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026 containing Exhibit 99.1, its Operating and Financial Review and Prospects for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim results disclosure, not a special situation; it incorporates the review by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf registration (No. 333-292786). No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch for interim financial trends and any subsequent shelf takedown activity.
